exact_arithmetic_contract: Each expert block reproduces qwen35_router_logits_kernel<uint16_t,float>: each lane accumulates its k=tid*8 + 2048*n groups in the same eight scalar F32 adds, then uses the same local256 stride-128..1 shared reduction and stores the identical FP32 logit.
After the logit store, threadfence plus one atomicAdd on the dedicated counter elects the last producer block without aliasing or clearing selected IDs.

The last block reproduces laguna_sigmoid_correction_topk_kernel: stable positive/negative sigmoid branches, separate unbiased routing_scores and correction-biased selection_scores, lower-ID tie order, ten serial selections, unbiased selected-probability sum normalization, and separate 2.5 scaling.
Thread 0 resets the dedicated counter only after logits, score arrays, selected IDs, normalized routing, and scaled routing are complete; a second same-stream launch needs no host memset.
selected_candidate.fallback: The separately registered router_logits/f32/bf16_hidden plus laguna_sigmoid_router_topk/f32/correction_bias chain remains mandatory for rows>1, gfx1151/unmeasured backends, registry/shape miss, explicit rollback, and any failed gate.

kernel_shape.counter: one session-local int32 initialized once and reset by last producer thread 0 after all output writes
kernel_shape.expected_resources: local256, dynamic LDS at least 1024 B, static LDS reported separately, VGPR <=48 preferred, scratch0

selected_candidate.why_selected: This is the largest fresh adjacent exact launch-contraction boundary after D10 removal: 0.896 ms/token measured short across 47 pairs, with 0.179 ms/token measured inter-kernel gaps and an already-retained gfx1100 last-block/persistent-counter tactic using the same exact F32 projection reduction. It is lower risk than reopening rejected quant output tiling and materially larger than the 0.121-ms attention-gate or 0.165-ms KV-write leaves.
